# `ceangal.storage`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_api_docs.py from ceangal/src/storage.almd; do not edit. -->

_Saved values and secrets._

Per-app storage: small strings that survive restarts (settings, drafts,
a list saved as JSON) and secrets (API keys, tokens) kept in the system's
credential store — Keychain, Android Keystore, Windows Credential Manager,
libsecret; the browser's localStorage on the web (docs/abi.md §4.6).

  storage.set("theme", "dark")
  let theme = storage.get("theme") ?? "light"

```almide
import ceangal.storage
```
